basic_profile.bio: I'm a 39-year-old gaming enthusiast from Scranton, Pennsylvania. By day, I work as a graphic designer, and by night, I immerse myself in the world of video games and online discussions. I'm new to Reddit but eager to learn and engage with communities. I enjoy connecting with people who share my interests, particularly in gaming and medical marijuana. When I'm not gaming, I'm often exploring new hobbies or spending time with my partner, with whom I've been sharing life for over a decade. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of video games, particularly those on the Nintendo Switch, thanks to years of gaming experience and self-teaching through forums and YouTube tutorials. My interest in medical marijuana stems from a personal journey towards wellness and an extensive amount of research, primarily conducted through community discussions and educational resources online.
